station.name: Krems
station.service: GeoSphere Austria (data, klima-v2-1m homogenised), 1991-2020 means computed by Tauernwetter Forschung (CC BY 4.0)
station.note: Official GeoSphere normals XLSX (klimaportal.geosphere.at/klimamittel/klimanormalperiode_19912020.xlsx) not reachable from the run (proxy blocked, binary for WebFetch). Cross-check vs GeoSphere annual review 2023 (handwerkundbau.at/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Jahr_23.pdf): Krems 2023 535 mm = 100% of normal -> normal ~535 mm (536 here); sun 1837 h = 102% -> ~1,800 h (computed 1,801 here).

comparison_station.name: Wien Hohe Warte
comparison_station.service: GeoSphere Austria data, 1991-2020 means by Tauernwetter Forschung
comparison_station.note: Cross-check 2023 review: 814 mm = 121% -> ~673 mm (674 here); 2003 h = 98% -> ~2,044 h (computed 2,042).

derived.computation: sun_month = h_per_day * days (Feb 28.25); sums; gst = mean(krems_tmean Apr..Oct); relief = e.max - e.min

facts.claim: 8 wine communes in the Wachau PDO (Aggsbach, Bergern im Dunkelsteinerwald, Dürnstein, Mautern an der Donau, Mühldorf, Rossatz-Arnsdorf, Spitz, Weißenkirchen in der Wachau)
facts.source: EU GI register via Open Wine Atlas details-at.json

facts.claim: Danube 1.2 km from the outline centroid; Vienna 72 km
Terrain over outline e=[193,439,920,208,629] m; max 920, min 193, relief 727
88% of the outline is metamorphic rock (schist, slate, gneiss)
The Danube cut its way through the Gföhl gneiss; stone terraces laid out in the Middle Ages on the steep slopes; cool downslope winds from the Waldviertel before harvest
facts.source: Austrian technical dossier, GI Wachauer Weinbrand (Bundesministerium für Gesundheit, 2015), EU eAmbrosia

facts.claim: Krems 536 mm a year; Wien Hohe Warte 674 mm
Krems sunshine about 1,800 h a year (computed 1,801); Vienna about 2,040 h (computed 2,042)
facts.source: GeoSphere Austria data 1991-2020 via Tauernwetter, computed

facts.claim: Krems April-October mean 15.8 °C; WSET cool up to about 16.5 °C
facts.source: GeoSphere data via Tauernwetter; WSET bands from Open Wine Atlas Study

facts.claim: Wachau DAC: exclusively hand-picked grapes; Riedenwein only Grüner Veltliner or Riesling (15% tolerance); no enrichment for Riedenwein
facts.source: Wachau DAC regulation, BGBl. II Nr. 200/2020 (5 May 2020)

facts.claim: Steinfeder up to 11.5% abv (feather grass); Federspiel not more than 12.5% (falconry); Smaragd at least 12.5% (emerald lizard of the dry stone walls)
